name: Retina Images
description: Provide an image effect to output images in high resolution format for high resolution displays.
project_description: Retina Images swaps in its own subclasses of core's four image-effect plugins (resize, scale, scale-and-crop, crop) via hook_image_effect_info_alter(). Each subclass adds a 'Retinafy' checkbox and a 'Resolution multiplier' number field (default 2) to the effect's configuration form; when Retinafy is on, the effect multiplies the configured width and height by the multiplier before applying the transform, so the generated derivative is rendered at 2x (or Nx) pixel dimensions for high-DPI / retina displays. It ships three optional example image styles (thumbnail_retina, medium_retina, large_retina) and an admin preview route/controller. It has no configuration form of its own and no external dependencies beyond core Image.
